instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Vault is a mid-scale restaurant chain operating 12 locations specializing in Mediterranean cuisine. The central kitchen manages over 70% of menu production, supporting satellite locations through optimized logistics and supply chains. We are currently evaluating kitchen display systems (KDS), AI-driven prep quantity forecasting models, and centralized procurement optimization tools to enhance operational speed.
answers.pastInitiatives: We successfully launched a digital customer onboarding flow last quarter that reduced average time from 12 days to 5 days. This cross-functional project involved product development, compliance review, and customer success teams. Early Net Promoter Score (NPS) results for customers onboarded through the new flow showed an improvement of 22 points over the legacy manual process.
answers.strategicGoals: Our primary objective is to reduce operating expenses by 15% over the next two years while maintaining current output levels. We have identified significant waste in manual processes and seek to implement high-ROI automation opportunities across order processing, invoicing, and customer support workflows. The goal is operational excellence without increasing headcount.
answers.teamSize: Our digital and innovation organization includes 80+ professionals across centers of excellence for AI/ML, cloud engineering, UX design, and agile delivery. We run an internal incubator program that has graduated 6 new digital products to market in the past two years, alongside a corporate venture capital arm that makes strategic minority investments in relevant startups.

opportunities.title: Inventory Reconciliation Automation Pilot
opportunities.rationale: Implement a low-risk AI script to automate the reconciliation of central kitchen inventory against satellite location usage data.

first_actions: Identify a pilot region with high discrepancy rates.
Select an off-the-shelf, low-cost integration tool (budget < $50k).
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve 85% inventory accuracy in the pilot region within 6 months.
milestones: Month 3: Pilot operation stable and data validated

opportunities.title: Automated Procurement Workflow for Low-Value Goods
opportunities.rationale: Focus on automating repetitive, low-risk procurement tasks (e.g., standardized raw material ordering) to reduce human error and processing time.

first_actions: Map the current top 10 manual purchasing steps.
Implement a basic ERP module workflow enhancement.
Train key buyers on the new system.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduce procurement cycle time by 10% and decrease processing errors by 20%.
milestones: Month 4: Full deployment in one satellite location

opportunities.title: Hyper-Localized Dynamic Menu Optimization AI
opportunities.rationale: Develop a predictive model that adjusts ingredient orders and prep quantities not just based on historical sales, but also real-time local factors (e.g., weather, local events) to minimize food waste.

first_actions: Establish a dedicated cross-functional 'waste reduction' task force.
Define KPIs for ingredient cost variance and spoilage rates.
Select and prototype basic predictive ML framework.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduce food spoilage and ingredient cost variance by 8% within the first year.
milestones: Month 3: Model training complete on historical data
Month 6: Full integration pilot in two locations

next_steps.action: Launch a formal scoping phase for the Inventory Reconciliation Automation Pilot.
Establish a dedicated cross-functional team and define success metrics for the Hyper-Localized Dynamic Menu Optimization AI feasibility study.

key_weaknesses: Slow internal decision-making process constrained by risk aversion and small leadership team communication channels.
Legacy manual procurement workflows that create significant operational friction and waste time for managers.
Cultural resistance to adopting new technology, stemming from a focus on stability over necessary velocity improvements.
Insufficient data governance structure needed to feed advanced AI/ML models reliably into operational decision-making.
